We do not know whether this provision will be widely applied in Australia so soon after the passage of the Bank Corporate Reform Act. However, we wonder why this was not included by the parliamentary committee that looked into this earlier in the year..” It would be better if bank managing directors were allowed more shares in other entities where they serve on other boards (as is done in the UK), but it is also unusual for them to do so because of the large impact on performance.
